items.title: Accident accounts: client has given several inconsistent accounts of the crash mechanism (Metro-North merged into him vs his car struck theirs vs sideswiped by a truck and hit the sidewalk), plus Ferrara's own account on a different road
Prior injuries: client said none at intake and 'not applicable' under oath, but his own records show a 2011 left ankle fracture
Scope of employment said to be never investigated, while the incident report marks Ferrara On-Duty heading to the jobsite
Notes say Kyle Pullano was never contacted, but the firm subpoenaed him for an EBT
Incident report described as missing / not produced, but it is annexed to defendants' response
Notes say no police report obtained, but the sworn discovery response says a police accident report is annexed
Notes say no scene photos, but the sworn response says plaintiff has 22 photographs
Coverage: Metro-North self-insured / no limit vs $100k/$300k confirmed vs Travelers policy on the incident report cover sheet
Index number mismatch (150940/2024 vs 160000/2024) and statute of limitations / another action pending exposure
IME dates in Clio (Sept 2026) conflict with the dates inside the IME reports (March 2026)
IME watchdog: conflicting accounts of which exam the watchdog attended and how long each exam lasted
Note says expert reports were served before the service emails were sent
Who is holding up the second surgery: client deferring vs surgeon vs scheduling vs re-evaluation
Document dates in Clio do not match the filing dates printed in the documents
Calendar shows a compliance conference held 2025-04-15, but the letter to the judge says no preliminary conference was set
Client lives in Texas but claims weekly PT and chiropractic in New York
Client claims total disability vs IME says he can return to work without restrictions
PT frequency stated as weekly in some items and twice a week in others; PT discharged in 2023 but notes continue
Request counts in task/calendar text (third, fourth request) do not match the actual number of approaches
Medical causation: clean CT the day after vs TBI on DTI months later; glenoid hypoplasia; defense experts say no trauma / resolved
Duplicate items: identical email bodies, repeated no-fault exhaustion notices, Medicaid lien dates out of order
